The '''Shadow''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] model produced by the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
